article.title: Can Technology Replace Teachers
article.content: Online platforms, AI tools, and adaptive software have transformed modern classrooms. They can personalize exercises, provide instant feedback, and expand access to quality resources. However, technology cannot fully replace teachers. Good teachers build trust, motivate students, and respond to emotional needs that software may miss. The most effective model is usually blended learning: technology handles routine practice while teachers guide discussion, critical thinking, and collaboration.
article.translation: 在线平台、AI 工具和自适应软件正在改变现代课堂。它们可以个性化练习、提供即时反馈，并扩大优质资源的可及性。然而，技术无法完全取代教师。优秀教师能够建立信任、激励学生，并回应软件可能忽视的情感需求。通常最有效的是混合式学习：技术负责常规练习，教师负责讨论引导、批判思维与协作能力培养。
